# source: cancel.sty v2.2, manual "The cancel package": the four commands,
# the \CancelColor hook, and Options. Math marks use the face's rule and
# clearance, overlapping by default. The explicit makeroom option
# reserves the mark's width; the value-size options retain the package's
# style table. Text-mode cancellation remains a named refusal.
body impl $\cancelto{0}{x}$
body impl $\cancel{y}$
body impl $\bcancel{z}$
body impl $\xcancel{w}$
pre inert:sets-later-math \renewcommand{\CancelColor}{\color{red}}
pre inert:sets-later-math \usepackage[samesize]{cancel}
pre inert:sets-later-math \usepackage[smaller]{cancel}
pre inert:sets-later-math \usepackage[Smaller]{cancel}
pre inert:sets-later-math \usepackage[makeroom]{cancel}
pre inert:sets-later-math \usepackage[overlap]{cancel}
pre inert:sets-later-math \usepackage[thicklines]{cancel}
body refuse:W0301 \cancel{q}
